# zstack_vni_range (Resource)

Manage a VNI range in a ZStack L2 VXLAN network pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zstack_l2vxlan_network_pool" "example" {
  name               = "example-vxlan-pool"
  zone_uuid          = "a1b2c3d4e5f6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c"
  physical_interface = "bond0"
}

resource "zstack_vni_range" "example" {
  name        = "example-vni-range"
  description = "Example VNI range"
  start_vni   = 1000
  end_vni     = 2000
  pool_uuid   = zstack_l2vxlan_network_pool.example.uuid
}

output "vni_range" {
  value = zstack_vni_range.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_vni` (Number) The last VNI in the range (1-16777214 for software SDN).
- `name` (String) The name of the VNI range.
- `pool_uuid` (String) The UUID of the L2 VXLAN network pool that owns the range.
- `start_vni` (Number) The first VNI in the range (1-16777214 for software SDN).

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the VNI range. Changing it recreates the range because the ZStack update API only accepts a name.
- `resource_uuid` (String) A custom UUID requested when creating the VNI range.
- `system_tags` (List of String) System tags sent while creating the VNI range.
- `tag_uuids` (List of String) Tag UUIDs attached while creating the VNI range.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the VNI range.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zstack_vni_range.example <uuid>
```
